I replied to Hollis in the thread: the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is **Gate 47**.

- **Record:** GBrain's only current note on this says Gate 47, from Pree's correction. Her earlier Dock 23 note has been withdrawn.
- **Channel:** Hollis is a member of #central-team. I read it from Pree's first message onward. She posted Dock 23 on Oct 14 and corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning. Nobody has posted anything about it since, so the correction stands.
